items.headline: [US Featured Stock] Albemarle, investment rating upgraded on lithium demand outlook... stock price slightly up
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) is seeing its stock price rise slightly as its investment rating is upgraded following analysis that lithium demand is stronger than expected. Mizuho raised its rating from Neutral to Buy.

items.headline: Albemarle gains as Mizuho upgrades stock on surging energy storage demand
items.snippet: Albemarle Corp shares advanced 4% in premarket following an upgrade from Mizuho, which cited accelerating demand for battery energy stationary storage as a catalyst for tighter lithium market balances. Outperform, $130 price target.

items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Fintel reports that on October 14, 2026, Mizuho upgraded Albemarle from Neutral to Outperform. Barclays initiated coverage Oct 13 with Equal-Weight; Argus maintained Buy Oct 7; UBS maintained Buy Oct 5.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage - BESS - demand has tipped the market balance into a favorable territory, the analyst tells investors in a research note. The firm is raising its 2027 Albemarle

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation ALB, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices have tanked ~80% from their late 2022 highs. Slowing electric vehicle sales, increased lithium supply, and other headwinds are weighing on Albemarle stock. Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares. Lithium price is up about 67% year over year, still well below all-time highs.
